meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 给指定 agent 组的容器装上 rtk 代理：把二进制只读挂载进容器，并在 settings.json 里加 PreToolUse 钩子，让每次 Bash 调用自动经 rtk 过滤，git、cargo 等开发命令输出被压缩，省 60–90% token，不用写 CLAUDE.md 说明。
howto.when: 当你要求把 rtk 装进某个 agent 组的容器时，由操作者在主机侧执行；装好并重启后，该组容器里每次 Bash 调用都被 rtk 接管过滤。

say.text: 运行 add-rtk 技能，把 rtk 装到主机上
say.note: 执行安装脚本，二进制放到 ~/.local/bin/rtk

say.text: 把 rtk 只读挂载到 ag-xxx 这个组的容器里

howto.what_en: Installs rtk into a target agent container: mounts the binary read-only and adds a PreToolUse hook in settings.json, so every Bash call is filtered through rtk, compressing git, cargo, pytest etc. output and cutting tokens 60–90%.
howto.when_en: Runs when you ask to install rtk into an agent group's container; it is a host-side operator action. Afterwards every Bash call in that group's containers is intercepted by rtk.

say_en.text: Run the add-rtk skill and install rtk on this host
say_en.note: Runs the install script; binary goes to ~/.local/bin/rtk

say_en.text: Mount rtk read-only into agent group ag-xxx
say_en.note: Calls ncl groups config add-mount with --ro

say_en.text: Add the rtk hook claude PreToolUse hook and restart the container
say_en.note: Bash calls then go through rtk
